answer: Hardware-rooted attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to execute inside certified secure enclaves. This acts as a velvet rope against a gale of bot registrations. Because valid quotes require endorsement keys fused into silicon, an attacker cannot wander into the network with virtual clones and incurs the verifiable cost of buying physical processors. A key limitation is that side-channel vulnerabilities can leak private keys, breaking attestation integrity.
